description: This file contains CUDA device functions related to fused activations used in epilogues, including functions for copysign and optimized tanh, within the cutlass library's epilogue thread namespace.

methods.name: copysignf_pos
methods.description: Returns a float with the magnitude of 'a' and the sign of 'b'.

methods.name: tanh_opt
methods.description: Computes an optimized hyperbolic tangent of 'x', using different implementations based on CUDA version and architecture.
